name: stock-watch
description: /stock: watch tickers and get a chime when one reaches the low or high you set. Works any time, in any session.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Default 60, minimum 30. How often prices are fetched while a session is open. A blank value uses the default.

sound.title: Alert sound
sound.description: chime: a rising tone at your high, a falling tone at your low. chime and voice: also says the ticker aloud (macOS). off: the toast only.
